pages.title: UGC (Promotion of Equity in HEIs) Regulations, 2026

facts.text: UGC notified new regulations against caste-based discrimination in HEIs — replacing 2012 regulations
facts.head: News

facts.text: Covers: SCs, STs and OBCs (OBCs were excluded in draft) — aligns with Articles 15(4), 15(5)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Equal Opportunity Centre (EOC): mandatory in every HEI; bi-annual reports
facts.head: Provisions

facts.text: Equity Committee: under each EOC, chaired by Head of Institution; SC, ST, OBC, PwD, women members; meets at least twice a year
facts.head: Provisions

facts.text: Annual equity compliance report to UGC; Head personally responsible
facts.head: Provisions

facts.text: National monitoring committee by UGC
facts.head: Provisions

facts.text: Penalties: debar from UGC schemes, bar degree/online/distance programmes, remove from UGC list
facts.head: Provisions

facts.text: Dropped from draft: fine on students for "false complaints", OBC exclusion
facts.head: Provisions

facts.text: Gaps: no explicit admission-stage discrimination; ban on "separate educational systems" (2012) removed
facts.head: Provisions

facts.text: Evidence cited: IIT Delhi (2019) — 75% of marginalised students faced discrimination; Thorat Committee (2007)
facts.head: Provisions

pages.title: Malaria — Asia-Pacific and World Malaria Report 2025

facts.text: World Malaria Report 2025 (WHO, December) — Asia-Pacific a bright spot
facts.head: News

facts.text: Asia-Pacific: 10 of 17 endemic countries declined; cases 9.6 million (2023) → 8.9 million (2024); big drop in Pakistan
facts.head: News

facts.text: Historic lows 2nd year in Cambodia, Lao PDR, Vietnam; Greater Mekong Subregion tackled drug resistance
facts.head: News

facts.text: Financing: only 42% of global needs met in 2024
facts.head: News

facts.text: India target: zero indigenous cases by 2027 (global 2030); currently off track
facts.head: News

facts.text: Five States + Northeast = ~80% of India's burden
facts.head: News

facts.text: ⚠ Artemisinin resistance not yet established in India; oral artemisinin monotherapy banned
facts.head: News

facts.text: Cause: protozoan Plasmodium; vector — female Anopheles
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Species: P. falciparum (deadliest), P. vivax, P. malariae, P. ovale; India mainly falciparum and vivax
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Incubation: 10–14 days; liver (pre-erythrocytic) then RBC stage
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Treatment: ACT; vaccines: RTS,S and R21 (prioritised for Africa)
facts.head: Background

facts.text: ⚠ TB is caused by Mycobacterium, malaria by Plasmodium
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Bacterial skin infection — Streptococcus and Staphylococcus; affects subcutaneous tissue (legs, feet)
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Not contagious; treated with antibiotics
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Congenital defect of spinal cord; India lacks large-scale folic acid prevention programme
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Types: Myelomeningocele (most severe), Meningocele, Spina Bifida Occulta (mildest)
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Prevention: folic acid in early pregnancy
facts.head: Facts
